description: Shared agentbox.provider v1 fixtures. direction is the sender. frame is the frame text; frame_hex raw bytes; frame_parts a list of parts where {repeat, count} stands for repeat concatenated count times. canonical is the expected encoding when it differs from frame. argv lists the arguments after ENTRY. exchanges run their steps in order against one Exchange: host/provider frames (provider_parts as frame_parts), exit (the invocation ended with that status) and disconnect (an SSH connection ended); capabilities names the provider's described frame in described, and worker_sha256 the prepared image's worker the host holds, absent meaning none. error is the first refusal code; later steps still run and change nothing. outcome is the final outcome: null while pending or when the first request was refused before sending; end error (settlement unknown) after any refusal, even one following a terminal frame.
